title: digital fabrication
description: PROTOTYPNG   is a way to connect with materiality, tangibility and form. Over years i had the chance to experiment with different techniques of digital fabrication and rapid prototyping, such as Laser Cutting, Biomaterials Making, 3D modelling and printing, designing and assembling (smart or dumb) machines using both software and hardware, woodworking.
Those projects are all available on my github page.
